[carrawa] Indoor only.
7.12 pm said temporarily out of stock and working on more stock or just me?
[edrift] I've been using 4 outdoors under the eaves for quite awhile now.
No issues at all.
[carrawa] Thanks. Good to know. Anything you feel someone needs to know about these?
[bobvegas] they have quite bad low light, the IR light doesn't illuminate very far and in my yard very dark, when it rains or spiders make cobwebs it will see people everywhere, for the price I still like them, but I've since replaced them all with Tapo C120, much better low light and AI detection, but C120 is not pan/tilt.
[yak] Not just you.
Temporarily out of stock.
We are working hard to be back in stock as soon as possible.
[51OL] It was $44 for 2 pack from jb hifi. Lazy to find the link but it's true.
[bargaino] They work OK with frigate. Not bad for a cheap wifi camera anyway.
[dealmaker] Does it need internet (other than initial setup)?
Need to use it in a not-connected place, can connect it to router for wifi
[dealmaker] found the answer, yes it works.
mobile device needs needs to be on the same wifi network (duh!) with mobile data OFF (important) to access the cameras from the app and view footage.
has rtsp stream too, very handy for an off-site setup instead of fiddly sd cards
thanks op, got one
[Knightchampion] Anyone got any deals for outdoor versions?
[bobvegas] C120 was on sale for $49 at Amazon but it's sold out, Bunnings looks to be price matching Amazon (or visa versa), they still have it at that price, but special order, it's not on the shelves at Bunnings, they order it for you to collect a few days later.
[Commodore64] Did anyone manage to make these work locally without a huge headache?
[bargaino] Yes, as reported above. Just enable onvif/rtsp in the app, then you won't need app or cloud again.
